summary.text: Jeremy Dean is a Democratic state representative who has represented Missouri House of Representatives District 132 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He serves on the House General Laws Committee and the House Economic Development Committee.

paragraphs.text: Dean was born in Springfield, Missouri, and earned a high school diploma from Willard High School in 2015.
He succeeded Crystal Quade, a Democrat, in the District 132 seat and took office on January 8, 2025.
For the 2025-2026 session, Dean was assigned to the House General Laws Committee and the House Economic Development Committee.
